title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 6.7 Exponential and Logarithmic Models: Model exponential growth and decay.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 6.7 Exponential and Logarithmic Models: Model exponential growth and decay.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "6.7 Exponential and Logarithmic Models", prints these objectives: "Model exponential growth and decay." "Use Newton’s Law of Cooling." "Use logistic-growth models." "Choose an appropriate model for data." "Express an exponential model in base e .". The section text says: "We have already explored some basic applications of exponential and logarithmic functions. In this section, we explore some important applications in more depth, including radioactive isotopes and Newton’s Law of Cooling." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
